suggestedOps.refusal.nameTaken.suggestio: Vraag Ask Cmdr om een andere naam voor te stellen.

@suggestedOps.server.field.account.sameAsSourceJustification: Dutch for a user account is "account" (het account): the nl termbase rules account → account (high), and the catalog already uses it (servers.sheet.accountLocked, servers.sheet.s3AccountId → Account-ID).

@suggestedOps.server.field.bucket.sameAsSourceJustification: Dutch for an S3 bucket is "bucket": Microsoft terminology renders "bucket" (a virtual container) as "bucket" (DUTCH.tbx in the reference pile, 2026-10-02), matching servers.sheet.s3Bucket.
